name: Orange Roots
why_it_matters: The most-cited pure-vegetarian restaurant in Cherrapunji — humble, hygienic, run by an all-women Khasi staff in traditional attire. Repeatedly described on Tripadvisor as 'probably the best restaurant in the northeast' for travellers wanting Jain-friendly North/South Indian.
insider_tip: Dine-in closes around 4.30-5 PM; takeaway runs until 7-7.30 PM. Plan a late lunch, not a dinner. Cash preferred.
signature_address: Main Sohra Bazaar, near Sohra market, Sohra (Cherrapunji), East Khasi Hills, Meghalaya 793108

name: Cafe Cherrapunjee
signature_dish: Khasi-style smoked pork in a Raj-era setting
why_it_matters: An old-world cafe-restaurant set among ancient pines on the Shillong-Sohra highway, with a gramophone, fireplace and Raj-era posters. Famous for Khasi-style smoked pork and serving as the iconic Shillong-to-Cherrapunji halfway stop.
insider_tip: Sits at Mawkdok, roughly 30 km from Sohra town — best as a lunch stop on the way down from Shillong, not a Sohra-base dinner option.
signature_address: Lower Cherrapunji highway, Mawkdok, East Khasi Hills, Meghalaya 793108

name: Sohra House (Polo Orchid Resort)
signature_dish: Cliffside dining with Seven Sisters Falls views
why_it_matters: The in-house multi-cuisine restaurant at Polo Orchid Resort — split into a courtyard, a bar, a buffet section and a one-of-a-kind cliffside dining deck overlooking the Seven Sisters Falls valley. Open to outside guests, not just resort residents.
insider_tip: Cliffside section is small — book the sunset slot (5.30-7 PM) ahead. The drive in from Sohra town is ~5 km on the Mawsmai-Nongthymmai road.
signature_address: Polo Orchid Resort, Mawblang, near Seven Sisters Waterfalls, Sohra (Cherrapunji), Meghalaya 793108

name: Jiva Grill (Jiva Resort)
must_try: sizzling brownie with butterscotch ice cream
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor's current #1-ranked Sohra restaurant — large windows framing valley views, occasional live music nights, and signature grilled dishes inspired by global and regional flavours. Part of Jiva Resort but open to walk-ins.
insider_tip: Banana-leaf grilled pork and fish need to be ordered ~30 minutes ahead. Live music isn't every night — call to confirm.
signature_address: Jiva Resort, Saitsohpen, Sohra (Cherrapunji), East Khasi Hills, Meghalaya 793108
